redLines: Never alter the spoken words: words, spelling and order match the transcript (with the user's edits); the LLM only adds punctuation and breaks; every word appears exactly once, including at part seams.
Never guess a timing: cue times come from the audio; a stretch that cannot be timed is flagged and reported, never estimated.
Never overwrite the user's edits silently: a re-run keeps hand corrections, or refuses and says why.
Keys and voice stay the user's: API keys never reach code, the repo or logs; the voice goes only to services the user configured.
